subject: planner: support hash v2 variable to control the join order (#58546)
summary: Change gates HASH_JOIN_BUILD/PROBE join-order control for SemiJoin/AntiSemiJoin behind `tidb_hash_join_version=optimized` (UseHashJoinV2 + env support + join supported), emitting hint warnings and ignoring build/probe hints under legacy/unsupported cases; moves `IsHashJoinV2Supported` into `executor/join/joinversion` and updates executor builder accordingly.
